label: Precision Resin (SLA) 3D Printer
description: Uses a UV laser to cure liquid resin into a high-detail physical replica of a digital scan.

components.function: Hardens the print after it's finished.
Cleans off excess liquid resin with Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA).

game_mechanics.scaling_factor: Player can print a 'Micro-Fauna' tooth at 10x size so they can show the serrations to a tour group.
game_mechanics.model_fragility: Prints need 'supports' removed manually (a mini-game using the Style 5 tweezers!).
